name: Hospitality and Tourism Management
description: Hotels, resorts, restaurants, events, cruise and theme parks — the management side of the industry Florida is built on. ⚠⚠ 22 Florida public institutions award 1,745 credentials under the general code, 1,206 of them bachelor's. ⚠⚠⚠ And the education sits exactly where the industry does: FIU (667) and UCF (590) produce 72% of the state's output, which is Miami and Orlando.
degreesNote: ⚠⚠ THE DEGREE IS CONCENTRATED IN TWO CITIES. Of 1,745 credentials under Hospitality Administration/Management, Florida International awards 667 and the University of Central Florida 590 — together 72% of the state total, with Florida State third at 224 and Valencia fourth at 64. ⚠ That is Miami and Orlando, which is where the cruise industry and the theme parks are, and it means a student outside those two metros is choosing between relocating and a much smaller local programme. ⚠⚠⚠ AND THE DEGREE IS NOT THE GATE TO MOST OF THE INDUSTRY'S JOBS. Lodging managers report 72% of employers requiring a bachelor's — but food service managers report 30% accepting a high school diploma, 21% a postsecondary certificate and 19% an associate degree, and food service management is SEVEN TIMES the occupation by headcount at nearly identical pay. ⚠ What the bachelor's buys is the corporate and lodging side, and speed of promotion — not entry. Decide which of those you are paying for. ⚠⚠ THE SHORT CREDENTIALS ARE REAL AND THEY ARE ELSEWHERE IN THE FAMILY: Hotel/Motel Administration (52.0904) is 251 credentials at 12 institutions, ALL certificates, led by Valencia at 97 and Broward at 53; Restaurant/Food Services Management (52.0905) is 105 at 13; and the catering and hotel-restaurant codes add another 49 at 9. ⚠ Those are state-college and technical-college credentials and they are the cheap way in. ⚠ Meeting and Event Planning (52.0907) is different again — 157 credentials at just TWO institutions, 140 of them UCF bachelor's.

cips.note: Hospitality Administration/Management, General — 22 Florida public institutions and 1,745 credentials in 2023: 1,206 bachelor's, 320 master's, 159 associate, 40 postbaccalaureate certificates. ⚠ FIU 667 and UCF 590 between them are 72% of the state's output; Florida State 224, Valencia 64, FAU 51.

Hotel/Motel Administration/Management — 12 Florida public institutions, 251 credentials, ⚠ ALL of them certificates (200 of twelve weeks to a year, 51 of one to two years). Valencia 97, Broward 53, St Petersburg 34. The short route into lodging operations.

Restaurant/Food Services Management — 13 Florida public institutions, 105 credentials: 48 short certificates, 33 one-to-two-year certificates, 20 bachelor's, 4 associate. St Petersburg 23, UCF 20, Miami Dade 13.

⚠ Meeting and Event Planning — only 2 Florida public institutions and 157 credentials, of which 140 are UCF bachelor's and 17 FAU certificates. The narrowest door in the family and almost entirely one institution.
Resort Management — a single carrier, Florida Gulf Coast University, awarding 68 bachelor's. Claimed so FGCU is listed; it is the only resort-specific degree in the Florida public system.

Hotel, Motel, and Restaurant Management — 9 Florida public institutions and 49 credentials, all short certificates. St Petersburg 15, Broward 11, Valencia 10. Combined operations training at state colleges.

related.note: ⚠⚠ The substitute a great many hospitality managers actually hold, and a more portable one. A business degree with operations and finance coursework competes for the same corporate posts and is taught at far more Florida institutions. ⚠ Hospitality-specific study wins on industry knowledge and internship networks; business wins if you might leave the industry.

⚠ Named because revenue management — pricing rooms and covers by demand — is the highest-leverage skill in this industry and is a marketing discipline. ⚠⚠ HFT2500 Hospitality and Tourism Marketing is carried by 10 Florida institutions, and the people who do it well are the ones who get promoted.

⚠ Named for the same reason the marketing link is there: hospitality management is a margin business, and the managers who control food cost, labour cost and occupancy are the ones who move up. FSS2500 Food Service Costing and Controls is carried by 6 institutions.

⚠ Not a route, and named only as an honest comparison for a student weighing service-sector management degrees. Health care administration reaches a $123,860 median against lodging management's $69,250, is taught at 24 Florida institutions with 20 state colleges carrying the upper-division work, and is far less geographically concentrated.
